verdicts.reason: A gets the hierarchy wrong. The quote is small and runs as one wide block, while the bold green attribution is jammed right under it at almost the same visual weight. The opening quote mark has shrunk to a speck, the logo floats oversized in the top right, the can sits off-axis in the middle under the text, and the bottom-left corner is left as dead space. B rearranges the layout sensibly into a left column (logo, large quote mark, then the quote with a good wrap, then the attribution) with the can kept inside the purple circle on the right. It is faithful to the original. Its flaws are minor: the logo is slightly heavy, the gap between the quote mark and the quote is loose, and the quote text is on the small side for 300x250.
